kpi.title: KPI Settings
kpi.subtitle: Evaluation criteria, 75/25 pool parameters and position salaries.

kpi.emptyWindowFactorHint: Applied to teams with no finished projects in the window — seasonal, may be adjusted monthly.
kpi.salariesDesc: Full salary per position × department — no per-person salaries stored. A newer period row overrides older ones from its effective period.
kpi.noSalaries: No salary rows for this period yet.

costsheet.contingencyPctHint: Applied on direct CO total — adds to internal cost (CO).
costsheet.discountPctHint: Only used when deriving a suggested CE from CO — does not affect the margin gate.

costsheet.rejectNoteRequired: A reason is required to reject
costsheet.overrideNote: Reason for going below the margin floor (sent to the approver)
costsheet.autoApproved: Eligible for auto-approve (below threshold & margin OK)
costsheet.sectionDepartmentHint: Sets the code prefix for every line in this section (e.g. OPE-001). Codes are auto-assigned on save.
costsheet.overrideNotePlaceholder: Reason for approving below the margin floor…
costsheet.agencyFeePctHint: Presentation-only on the exported quotation (lines → +fee → +VAT). Does not affect margin.
costsheet.colSponsoredHint: Quotation shows the unit price but charges nothing for this line (line CE = 0). CO still counts.
costsheet.stockPanelHint: Stock approved for this project. Inserting it into a section creates two lines: the stock line (zero unit price, quantity locked) and a top-up purchase line. On the client quotation the pair prints as a single line.
costsheet.stockQtyLocked: Quantity is locked to the approved reservation — cancel the reservation to change it.
costsheet.stockRefPriceHint: REFERENCE unit price for stock taken from the warehouse: excluded from cost, used only to allocate the client price on the quotation and to suggest make-up.
costsheet.colLegHint: Province / site / wave for this line. A label only — it never affects money. Used to group the acceptance sheet sent to the client.
costsheet.colTotalCoHint: VAT: before-tax only · PIT/CIT: before tax + tax
costsheet.colPayCapHint: VAT: before tax + VAT · PIT/CIT: before tax only — cumulative advance/payment cap per line
costsheet.proxyTag: PROXY — outside margin, separate service fee
costsheet.mergeHintSameSection: Lines must be in the SAME section to merge
costsheet.vatPctHint: Pick 8% or 10% — determines the supplier payment cap
costsheet.feeCardHint: Each top-level section belongs to exactly ONE fee rate. The proxy block has its own service fee and is excluded here.
costsheet.feeTakenHint: This section already sits in another fee rate
costsheet.feeMissing: ⚠ Management fee missing for: {names}. Assign them before exporting the quotation.
costsheet.feeOk: ✓ All top-level sections covered — the fee is included in the totals.

The grand total may differ by a few dong because the management fee is now rounded PER SECTION. The displayed margin changes denominator (computed on CE before VAT); no money is lost.
costsheet.convertNeedsCe: A CE total is required before converting
costsheet.ceTotalDerivedHint: Per-line CE mode: the total is derived from the lines, not typed in
costsheet.readOnlyNote: You are viewing this cost sheet read-only — you do not have permission to edit it.

documents.receiveHint: Count the goods and adjust received quantities if short/damaged — discrepancies stay visible on the document forever.
documents.adjustHint: Negative quantity = decrease. Use to compensate mistakes on completed documents (reference the document code in the note).
documents.returnHint: Returning short due to loss/damage: enter the actual returned quantity with a note — the unreturned part stays under "Out in the field".
documents.errorNoLines: The document needs at least one line.
documents.errorSameWarehouse: Source and destination warehouses must differ.
documents.errorReturnRequired: Documents with reusable items require a return due date.
documents.destroyHint: Destruction deducts stock directly — the only exit for expired / write-off goods. State the reason.
documents.convertHint: Changing status/condition moves quantity from the source lot to a target lot in the SAME warehouse. The target is the lot of the SAME PRODUCT matching the new combination (owner, project, expiry unchanged) — reused if it exists, otherwise created with the next lot number (PO-0042.03); multi-part sets move as a whole.
documents.errorExpired: Expired goods can only be destroyed: {items}
documents.errorConvertPart: {item} is a part of a set — pick the parent item to convert the whole set.
documents.errorConvertLegacy: {item} has no product or no status/condition (data older than lot code v3) — ask an admin to re-attach the lot to a product.
documents.errorConvertTarget: Could not build the target lot (part-set has mismatched parts or the lot lost its product) — check the product/parts and retry.
documents.errorConvertSame: {item}: new status/condition equals the current one.
documents.errorConvertSameInline: New status/condition must differ from the current one.
documents.errorSeqFull: This product is out of lot numbers (max 99).
documents.lossHint: Deducts the project's on-site goods WITHOUT crediting the warehouse. Use when goods are lost or damaged on site — a reason is required.
documents.holdingHint: Goods go straight from this project's site to another project's site without returning to the warehouse. The receiving side must confirm receipt IN FULL; if short, cancel the document and let the sender file a loss report for the shortfall.
documents.holdingReceiveHint: Receive IN FULL or cancel — no partial receipt. Any shortfall must go through the sender's loss report.
documents.errorSameProject: Sending and receiving projects must differ
documents.errorBoundOtherProject: Lot is in “Project-only” (exclusive) status of another project: {items}
documents.errorBoundThirdProject: Goods owned by a THIRD project (neither sender nor receiver) — a site-to-site transfer has no approver; return them to the warehouse and let the receiving project raise an issue request for the owner to approve: {items}
documents.errorOtherClientGoods: Goods belong to another client, cannot be cross-used: {items}
documents.redeclareHint: Declare the ACTUAL status/condition as the goods come back. If it differs from when they left, the quantity moves to a new lot code — the old code is never edited. One lot returning in several conditions: add one line per condition.
documents.redeclareNoPermHint: You can only return goods under their original lot. Re-declaring status/condition on return requires the lot-conversion permission (warehouse keeper).
documents.redeclarePartHint: Part of a split set: re-declaring must move the whole set via a lot-conversion document, not one part at a time.
documents.errorOverHolding: Lines total more than the quantity on site: {item}
documents.errorRedeclareForbidden: You may not re-declare lot status/condition. Remove the re-declaration or ask the keeper to file the document.
documents.errorClientLotNeedsRequest: Client-owned goods cannot be destroyed directly — file a disposal request for the owning Account team to approve: {items}

requests.subtitle: Issue to projects and report incoming goods — propose, approve, then the keeper confirms actual quantities.
requests.pendingMine: {count} item(s) waiting on you — pinned to the top.
requests.reusableHint: Required when reusable goods are included — drives the return reminder.
requests.intakeSourceHint: For goods bought on a PO, sent by a client, or opening stock — pick the PO if there is one. ⚠ Goods RETURNING FROM SITE must NOT be reported here (stock would be credited while the site holding is never debited, and the project gets locked after 15 days).

requests.destroyFlowHint: Destroy request for CLIENT-OWNED goods: the owning Account team approves per line, then the keeper confirms the actual quantity — only then is the destroy document created and stock deducted.
requests.issueFlowHint: This request does not deduct stock yet. After the project PIC (or AD/AM) approves, the keeper picks the goods and confirms actual quantities.
requests.intakeFlowHint: Reporting goods does not add stock yet. The keeper counts the goods and confirms actual quantities.
requests.confirmIssueHint: Enter what actually went out (never above the approved amount). Confirming deducts stock and creates the issue document.
requests.confirmIntakeHint: Enter what you actually counted (never above the reported amount). Confirming adds stock and creates the import document.
requests.notPicHint: You may approve, but you are not the PIC / Leader / team lead of the project that OWNS the goods on this request (or of the requesting project, for TCM general stock).
requests.errorProjectRequired: The project must be in execution.
requests.errorReturnRequired: Reusable goods included — a return due date is required.
requests.errorExpired: Expired goods can only be destroyed: {items}
requests.errorNotPic: Only the project PIC/leader or an AD/AM can approve this request.
requests.errorNotOwner: Only the requester or an approver can cancel this.
requests.errorAlreadyProcessed: This request was handled elsewhere — reload the page.
requests.errorNothingIssued: No issued quantity above 0 was entered.
requests.errorNothingReceived: No received quantity above 0 was entered — if nothing actually arrived, enter a reason to close this report.

requests.errorNotReadyToUse: Only lots marked “Ready to use” can be reserved: {items}
requests.errorOverReserveCap: Exceeds the quantity reserved and approved for this project: {items}

requests.confirmDestroyHint: Actual destroyed ≤ quantity approved by Account per line. Confirming creates a Destroy document and debits stock.
